{{Top|leg}}
'''Meditation beads''' were a type of beads used to aid individuals in [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Meditation beads are a random item found on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] while playing as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] or [[Jedi Consular]] in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The cost is one [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] and it is one of the cheapest miscellaneous items. They cannot be used.<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
